```{=html}
<div id="variance-demo" class="variance-demo">

<div class="variance-panel">

<div class="variance-controls">

<label class="variance-control">
<span>Mean of y</span>
<input data-param="mean" type="range" min="3" max="7" step="0.1" value="6.1">
<output data-value="mean"></output>
</label>

<label class="variance-control">
<span>Variance of y</span>
<input data-param="variance" type="range" min="0.5" max="4" step="0.1" value="1">
<output data-value="variance"></output>
</label>

<label class="variance-control">
<span>R²</span>
<input data-param="r2" type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.01" value="0.5">
<output data-value="r2"></output>
</label>

</div>

<div class="variance-results" aria-live="polite">

<div><span>TSS</span><strong data-result="tss"></strong></div>
<div><span>SSE</span><strong data-result="sse"></strong></div>
<div><span>RSS</span><strong data-result="rss"></strong></div>

</div>

</div>

<svg></svg>

</div>

<script>
varianceDemo("#variance-demo");
</script>
```
